exposure: Gestational week at birth (preterm or full-term status)
outcome: Existential meaning-making reflections related to birth experience
cohort: The study included 517 first-time mothers in Denmark who had given birth 6-18 months previously, sampled from the Danish Medical Birth Registry.
finding: Both full-term and preterm mothers reported existential meaning-making reflections, but mothers who gave birth preterm mainly identified negative aspects, whereas full-term mothers identified more positive aspects.
